observations.contract: Prepared dynamic geometry and sign policy
observations.trace: The worker geometry installer computes collision origin and dynamic openings before adding batch meshes, records Dynamic detail, explicitly constructs interior Some, and retains the passed program in its cache. Signs retain typed ShopSign and supported SignSite, select the requested mount or first available supported mount, allocate a board immediately and create/release lettering at 48/60 metres based on the nearest active 3D camera.
observations.remaining: Worker geometry/program/recipe identity, all camera and render-layer owners, actual font/cache validity and dynamic installation remain open. The earlier broad missing-interior claim is narrowed, not globally closed.

observations.trace: ClosureMeshes caches doors by exact LeafDimensions bits and windows by dimensions separately for glass and shutters; it only inserts a new window collection after compile_window_leaf succeeds. The current LeafDimensions constructor checks finite and strictly positive axes and Deserialize calls that constructor. The window observer selects the primary material and returns the typed MissingPrimaryMaterial error if absent; other material parts become separate children. Door/window instance transforms and native geometry remain separately owned.
observations.remaining: Actual window compiler, recipe conversion, native error handling, reflected construction paths and all admitted inputs are not closed. Earlier speculation that MissingPrimaryMaterial lacks a caller is narrowed by the actual window observer. Fixture assertions were not run.

observations.contract: City streaming error and progress ownership
observations.trace: PendingCityBuildings::advance removes one descriptor before calling the fallible production spawn; on error report_failure stores the first formatted Display string and the removed descriptor is not retained as structured failure context. completed is total minus queue length and finished is queue empty, so both include removed failed placements as processed. The production spawn returns Ok(true) after queueing the building and sign; its generic helper supports Ok(false) and requeues it, but this production body has no Ok(false) return.
observations.remaining: Actual admitted construction or prepared-facade failure is not demonstrated. On Wasm, take_facade can return a typed NotPrepared for an unmatched program, but valid producer/worker identity and reachability remain open. The native error may itself carry details; the queue does not retain the descriptor or typed cause as its own state. The earlier source fixture is not a runtime result.

observations.trace: The current art-demo report checks unfinished first, then reports the retained city error as Unavailable when drained; later scene or asset checks may replace that status. Strategic status checks the retained city failure when composing its exported error, and the browser checks error before ready. The earlier exact Lens12 role1449 batch423 reviewed the frozen art-demo body separately, and the prior 95e art-demo trace already rejected a blanket drained-queue false-ready claim for that branch.
observations.remaining: While pending remains unfinished the art demo reports Loading first; whether that delay is desired is a policy question. Other consumers, actual status timing and product effects remain unverified. Do not infer UI success from the queue becoming empty.

observations.contract: Strategic internal readiness versus exported failure
observations.trace: Strategic update_status requires a drained city queue in installed, but does not include city.failure() in installed or complete; it sets SceneInstallationReady and SceneAssetsReady from those predicates. It separately composes error from city.failure() and requires city GPU readiness for complete when city.total is nonzero. cached_views::settle uses installation readiness to prepare cameras and asset readiness to advance its capture counter, without reading the exported error; visibility also uses installation readiness as a per-root gate.
observations.remaining: If an admitted city placement fails, other placements and readiness gates succeed, the GPU ready flag becomes true, and a capture remains requested, source permits internal capture progress alongside an exported error. No failed placement, renderer, capture, status combination or browser behavior was observed. Intended degraded-capture policy and whether consumers need a typed failure gate remain open; this is distinct from the error-cause loss and from rootless host GPU assembly errors.

observations.trace: The exact role1521 historical/current diff changes only source-test fixture setup and names: historical tests call generation, while 95e tests reserve handles. The production prefix is byte-identical. The preceding city GPU assessment independently records the palette, ARM map adapter and native PBR source relationship.
observations.remaining: Neither version of the source tests ran. Identical production bytes do not imply historical review credit for the current revision, other roles or other lenses.
